diagnosis.description: Plain-language explanation of why this is an accessibility violation, grounded in the DOM/ARIA evidence provided.

repair_strategy.description: The approach chosen to fix it, and why this approach over alternatives.

path.description: Repo-relative path, exactly matching one of the source_files given in the input.

content.description: The COMPLETE new content of this file after the fix — the whole file, not a snippet or diff.

modified_files.description: One entry per file changed. Empty array if unrepairable is true.

risk_notes.description: Anything about this fix that could affect functionality, state handling, or styling. Empty string if none.

unrepairable.description: True if the agent could not produce a safe fix (in that case modified_files must be empty).
